concept.title: Build tool integration benefits
concept.shortdesc: connects seamlessly with your existing development pipelines so that you never have to modify your application code.

conbody.p: By making a single configuration change to your enterprise build tools, such as Artifactory, Nexus, or Maven, you immediately connect to the secure Red Hat repository.
Integrating with your build tools provides the following key benefits:

ul.li: Routes all the dependency resolutions directly through the secure repository.
Automatically pulls patched artifacts during your next dependency resolution.
Enhances your existing repositories with a secure, verified set of packages.
